programme.title: 我們的河山
programme.desc: 我們的河山改編自同名小説由劉戈建編劇，毛衛寧執導，王雷陳鈺琪焦俊豔張天陽領銜主演的一套以抗戰為題材的電視劇1937年，抗日烽火燃遍華夏在崮城縣，滿懷熱血的青年共產黨員莊埼風（王雷飾），在其上級領導周密的指導下，深入民間，展開了一場艱鉅的敵後鬥爭他們遵循論持久戰的戰略方針，透過減租減息組織農救會等方式，成功喚醒並團結了廣大群眾，將渙散的力量凝聚成抗日的洪流莊埼風不僅帶領民眾剷除魚肉鄉民的土匪，更組織武裝力量對日偽政權發起有力打擊在八路軍一一五師的支援下，軍民同心，生死相依，逐步建立起穩固的抗日根據地他們在敵人的高壓統治下，憑藉無比的勇氣與智慧，硬是撕開了一道封鎖的裂口，將孤勇化為合力最終，他們成功反擊了日軍的多次掃蕩，徹底擊潰了淪陷區的偽政權，迎來了抗戰的偉大勝利

programme.desc: 鷺航客運飛行部副部長顧南亭（王凱飾），以嚴苛自律和鐵血上司的形象深受眾人敬畏與之形成鮮明對比的是貨運女飛行員程霄（譚松韻飾），她性格爽朗不羈，即將晉升機長的她卻因公司改制被降至客運部的觀察員，重新踏上飛行之路命運的玩笑是，顧南亭成了程霄的直屬上司和導師，兩人的相遇註定了不尋常的火花ampampampampltbrampampampampgt顧南亭習慣於秩序和規章制度，而程霄卻喜歡不按常理出牌，經常讓他應接不暇一系列突發的航空事件接踵而至，要求他們合作應對，但他們的分歧和火藥味卻似乎更加激化了每一場危機顧南亭面對這位性格如此迥異的飛行員，既感到挑戰，也因其勇敢和獨立而歎為觀止在冰火交織的挑戰中，顧南亭和程霄必須找到一種合作的默契，才能化解每一次的險情，確保安全的背後他們的故事不僅僅是師徒間的碰撞，更是對於個性與團隊合作之間微妙平衡的探索

programme.desc: 前途無量改編自小説錢途，由白宇王志飛董勇李乃文王宥鈞主演，是一部以現代職場為題材的電視劇該劇由多位實力派老劇骨出演，以生活化的劇情背景講述職場逆襲，內容精彩絕倫！故事講述林強（白宇飾）是聯眾銀行總行授信審批部的副總經理，他不願意為問題貸款簽字，因此得罪了上級領導，被貶到業績表現最差的龍源支行，與林強同期進入銀行的摯友鄭帥（王宥鈞 飾）也受到牽連，一起被降職龍源支行管理混亂不堪，林強以出眾的專業能力，迅速發現了龍源的問題所在，很快建立起了一支工作團隊，並協助支行的員工們爭取應有的利益林強的行動激怒行長郝偉（李洪濤飾），開始對他施加種種壓力林強陷入事業危機，別無選擇下進行反擊，他查明了貸款案的問題，並成功解決最終，林強不僅實現了職業理想，也為銀行行業重新確立了秩序和規則，維護銀行人的初衷，展現出一個逆襲的職場故事

programme.desc: 我們的河山改編自同名小説由劉戈建編劇，毛衛寧執導，王雷陳鈺琪焦俊豔張天陽領銜主演的一套以抗戰為題材的電視劇1937年，抗日烽火燃遍華夏在崮城縣，滿懷熱血的青年共產黨員莊埼風（王雷飾），在其上級領導周密的指導下，深入民間，展開了一場艱鉅的敵後鬥爭他們遵循論持久戰的戰略方針，透過減租減息組織農救會等方式，成功喚醒並團結了廣大群眾，將渙散的力量凝聚成抗日的洪流莊埼風不僅帶領民眾剷除魚肉鄉民的土匪，更組織武裝力量對日偽政權發起有力打擊在八路軍一一五師的支援下，軍民同心，生死相依，逐步建立起穩固的抗日根據地他們在敵人的高壓統治下，憑藉無比的勇氣與智慧，硬是撕開了一道封鎖的裂口，將孤勇化為合力最終，他們成功反擊了日軍的多次掃蕩，徹底擊潰了淪陷區的偽政權，迎來了抗戰的偉大勝利

programme.desc: 我們的河山改編自同名小説由劉戈建編劇，毛衛寧執導，王雷陳鈺琪焦俊豔張天陽領銜主演的一套以抗戰為題材的電視劇1937年，抗日烽火燃遍華夏在崮城縣，滿懷熱血的青年共產黨員莊埼風（王雷飾），在其上級領導周密的指導下，深入民間，展開了一場艱鉅的敵後鬥爭他們遵循論持久戰的戰略方針，透過減租減息組織農救會等方式，成功喚醒並團結了廣大群眾，將渙散的力量凝聚成抗日的洪流莊埼風不僅帶領民眾剷除魚肉鄉民的土匪，更組織武裝力量對日偽政權發起有力打擊在八路軍一一五師的支援下，軍民同心，生死相依，逐步建立起穩固的抗日根據地他們在敵人的高壓統治下，憑藉無比的勇氣與智慧，硬是撕開了一道封鎖的裂口，將孤勇化為合力最終，他們成功反擊了日軍的多次掃蕩，徹底擊潰了淪陷區的偽政權，迎來了抗戰的偉大勝利

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: NCIS 시즌8
programme.desc: 최고의 특수 요원들이 미 해군과 해병대에 관련된 모든 범죄를 수사하는 과정을 흥미진진하게 담은 범죄 수사물. 지난 시즌7부터 시즌8까지 매회 전미 시청률 1위를 기록하며 폭발적인 인기를 얻고 있는 작품이다. 특히 이번에 방송되는 시즌8은 미국에서도 지난 9월말 첫방송을 시작, 현지에서 인기리에 방송중인 최신작으로, 국내 시청자들도 미국 시청자들과 큰 격차없이 안방극장에서 만나볼 수 있다고. 진지한 범죄 수사과정 속에서 독특하고 개성 넘치는 캐릭터들의 유머 코드가 결합해, 색다른 범죄수사물로 자리잡으며 시청자들의 뜨거운 관심을 받고 있다.

programme.title: 방과후 옥상
programme.desc: 운 없기로는 로또 1등감인 사나이 남궁달, 전학과 함께 새 삶을 시작하려는 첫날,하필이면 퀸카를 괴롭히는 학교 캡짱에게 시비를 걸어 방과후 옥상으로 끌려갈 처지가 되고 만다. lt광식이 동생 광태gt의 봉태규 주연의 코미디 영화

programme.title: 스위치
programme.desc: 캐스팅 0순위 천만배우이자 자타공인 최고의 스캔들 메이커 박강. 화려한 싱글 라이프를 만끽하고 있지만, 정작 크리스마스이브에 끌어안을 것이라고는 연말 시상식 트로피뿐. 유일한 친구이자 뒤처리 전문 매니저 조윤을 붙잡아 거하게 한잔하고 택시를 잡아탄다. 다음날 아침, 낯선 집에서 깨어난 박강에게 생전 처음 보는 꼬맹이 둘이 안겨오고, 성공을 위해 이별했던 첫사랑 수현이 잔소리를 폭격하며 등짝 스매싱을 날리는 것이 아닌가? 게다가 매니저 조윤이 천만배우가 되어 그가 있어야 할 톱스타의 자리를 꿰차고 있는데 이게 무슨 황당한 시추에이션?! 180도 뒤집어진 인생에 속이 뒤집어지는 박강은 불현듯, 지난밤 택시 기사가 무심코 건넨 한마디가 떠오르는데 quot만약에 선택을 바꿀 기회가 생긴다면, 어떻게 하시겠어요?quot

programme.desc: 조금은 건방지고 장난을 좋아하는 5살 유치원생 신짱구가 주인공으로, 부모님은 물론 주위의 어른들이 짱구가 일으키는 장난들에 휘말리고 마는 일상을 재미있게 그린 코믹 애니메이션. 투니버스에선 2001년 첫 방영을 시작하였으며, 현재까지도 시청자들에게 가장 큰 사랑을 받고 있는 작품 중 하나이다. 특히, 이번 lt짱구는못말려10gt은 짱구 출판 20주년, 방송 10주년을 기념하여 방영되는 시즌으로, 국내에선 한 번도 공개되지 않은 새로운 시즌이 방영될 예정이다.

programme.title: 신비아파트 고스트볼 X의 탄생
programme.desc: 지하국대적을 물리친 이후 하리와 두리는 꼬마 도깨비 신비와 함께 평화로운 나날을 보낸다. 그러던 어느 날, 신비아파트가 흑마법의 저주에 걸렸다는 것을 알게 되는데... 저주로 인해 더 강력해진 귀신들과 업그레이드된 고스트볼로 맞서 싸우는 하리! 그리고 알 수 없는 힘 때문에 괴로워하는 강림과 하리 앞에 새롭게 나타난 신비로운 소년 리온까지! 진짜 귀신은 지금부터다! 한 차원 더 업그레이드된 일상 속 공포! 더 무섭고, 더 강력해진 모습으로 신비아파트가 돌아왔다!

programme.title: 지식채널e
programme.desc: 과학, 생명, 문화유산, 가족, 교육, 직업, 한글등의 가치있는 수준높은 영상을 선사합니다. 지식채널e는 단순한 지식을 전달하는 프로그램이 아니라 지식을 바라보는 시각입니다. 시청자 여러분이 세상을 보는 많은 창들 중에 아주 작은 하나가 되기를 바랍니다.

programme.title: 스튜디오 K 스페셜

programme.title: 라디오스타
programme.desc: 잘나가는 DJ들이 TV에서 뭉쳤다. 고품격 음악방송을 추구하는 들리는 TV 라디오스타!

programme.title: 휴먼다큐 사노라면
programme.desc: 서민들의 소소하지만 위대한 일상을 통해 삶의 비법을 풀어가는 보통 사람들의 특별한 이야기.

programme.title: 놀라운 토요일
programme.desc: 토요일 저녁! 가족이 모여 함께 즐길 수 있는 예능 프로그램

programme.title: 스포츠 전쟁 강연배틀쇼 사기꾼들
programme.desc: 대한민국 강연계 레전드들이 펼치는 강연배틀쇼 사기꾼들! 하나의 주제, 각기 다른 이야기로 벌이는 한 판 승부! 과연 최고의 사기꾼은 누가 될 것인가!

programme.title: YTN 24
programme.desc: 뉴스 채널 YTN의 기본축을 이루는 뉴스 프로그램. 정확성과 속보성을 최대한 살려 최신 정보를 필요로하는 시청자들의 욕구를 만족시켜 준다. 특히 뉴스 휠 방식을 도입함으로써 그 날의 주요 뉴스와 함께 방송시간 직전까지 기자들이 송고한 최신 소식을 매시간 뉴스 편집에 반영함으로써 가장 생생한 소식을 시청자들에게 전달한다. 또 진행 중인 사건, 사고의 변화되는 상황을 그때 그때 전달해 뉴스에 대한 시청자들의 궁금증을 해소하고 전반적인 변화에 대한 시청자들의 이해를 돕는다.

programme.title: 자막 버려진 성녀의 이세계 밥 여행: 숨겨진 스킬로 캠핑카를 소환했습니다
逆轉女王
programme.desc: 經典韓劇賢內助女王姊妹作黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標

programme.title: 包青天
programme.desc: 宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱包青天，為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調人在做天在看舉頭三尺有神明不畏強權，除惡務盡

programme.title: 英雄訣
programme.desc: 燕王朱棣從小就表現出驚人的毅力和膽識，是眾兄弟中最出類拔萃的一個，但因為不是長子而無緣太子位太子朱標意外亡故後，朱元璋立皇孫朱允炆朱棣被削藩逼得無路可退，無奈起兵，在長達四年的靖難之役後，終於入主京師朱棣擁有了天下，卻背上了千古罵名，也失去了心中的摯愛朱棣用後半生的勵精圖治改寫大明的歷史，營建紫禁城，遷都北京，五次親征漠北，編成永樂大典，派遣鄭和下西洋，建立了不朽功績當他最後一次徵北時病逝於凱旋的歸途中

programme.title: 上陽賦
programme.desc: 皇權腐朽，貴族奢靡，不顧百姓生死郡主王儇，與初戀三皇子子澹青梅竹馬，卻因預言得之得天下，被捲入朝堂爭鬥，成為父親的一顆棋子，嫁給出身寒門的豫章王蕭綦大婚之夜，蕭綦被迫離開京城，王儇蒙羞，心灰意冷賀蘭王子綁走王儇向蕭綦尋仇，夫妻二人因禍得福相知相愛王儇被蕭綦守護天下子民盛世太平的心願感動二人因王謝兩族爭權太后陷害致夫妻流落分離兩人歷經萬苦重聚，滅叛軍，平邊境賀蘭族之亂在叛將謀反時，王儇拼死將無心皇位的子澹護送出京，保他平安王儇帶兵守城，九死一生，終於堅守到邊境平亂的蕭綦趕回最終，夫妻倆攜手開創新紀元，共同守護家國百姓

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 蒼穹之昴
programme.desc: 該劇以甲午戰爭至戊戌政變這一段時期為大背景，講述了一個靠撿拾街道上冰凍的牛糞馬糞維生的窮小子春兒，遇到了占星師白婆婆，白婆婆説他是天上的昴宿星降生，他的命與乾隆秦始皇一樣，未來將盡取中國一切財寶納入囊中她的預言，支撐着苦命的春兒活下去，當他兄長死於飢餓後，他自閹入宮，經過一番奮鬥與賣命，成為慈禧太后身邊的大紅人，接替李蓮英之位，白婆婆的語言似乎真的應驗了，然而他卻不經意地被捲入政治的漩渦

programme.desc: 皇權腐朽，貴族奢靡，不顧百姓生死郡主王儇，與初戀三皇子子澹青梅竹馬，卻因預言得之得天下，被捲入朝堂爭鬥，成為父親的一顆棋子，嫁給出身寒門的豫章王蕭綦大婚之夜，蕭綦被迫離開京城，王儇蒙羞，心灰意冷賀蘭王子綁走王儇向蕭綦尋仇，夫妻二人因禍得福相知相愛王儇被蕭綦守護天下子民盛世太平的心願感動二人因王謝兩族爭權太后陷害致夫妻流落分離兩人歷經萬苦重聚，滅叛軍，平邊境賀蘭族之亂在叛將謀反時，王儇拼死將無心皇位的子澹護送出京，保他平安王儇帶兵守城，九死一生，終於堅守到邊境平亂的蕭綦趕回最終，夫妻倆攜手開創新紀元，共同守護家國百姓

programme.title: 商道新
programme.desc: 19世紀紅頂商人林尚沃的發跡傳奇，大長今團隊經典之作原本立志成為譯官的林尚沃，卻因一場冤案家破人亡，淪為官奴他毅然投身商道，從基層夥計一步步崛起，憑藉過人的智慧誠信與膽識，在商戰中屢破困局，與宿敵鄭治壽展開跨越半生的競爭，也與命運多舛的多寧譜出刻骨銘心的愛情尚沃始終堅守以義取利的信念，更以商業改善民生造福百姓，最終成為朝鮮第一商人，譜寫出商海不朽傳奇

programme.desc: 一旦遇見祂，將迷失於山中嘉銘玉欣和安偉是大學登山社的好友某次登山途中，他們意外迷失方向，儘管沿路綁上白布條作記號，卻不斷繞回原處，彷彿陷入無盡迴圈荒亂之際，濃霧中隱約出現一個身穿黃色雨衣的身影，讓三人燃起希望；沒想到，詭異現象卻接連發生，真正的噩夢才剛剛開始

programme.title: 新年泰瘋狂
programme.desc: 真真夢想成為網紅，在閨蜜的幫助下，在網上打造一個富家網美版真真，把自己包裝成公主形象沒想到網美真真卻爆紅，成為人氣網紅一次，她遇到泰國背包遊客Nat，兩人一見鍾情的故事很快曝光，人氣更上一樓其實，Nat是個富二代，但是現實中的真真家裡經濟條件不好現在為了保持高人氣，真真只好繼續在網上演戲，家人和朋友也全家出動配合演戲

programme.title: 國產淩淩漆

programme.title: 殭屍叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山間，一僧一道比鄰而居和尚隨和開朗，有一女徒菁菁玲瓏可愛；道士古板嚴厲，徒弟嘉樂卻鬼馬頑皮性格不同的兩個師傅口角不斷，兩個冤家徒弟也笑料頻出某天，一支邊疆皇族屍隊路過此地，遭遇暴雨雷劈，殭屍破棺而出，大開殺戒烏侍郎攜王子僥倖逃命，但王子已中屍毒和尚與道士命徒兒照看王子，兩人則衝入樹林尋找千鶴道長

programme.title: 葉問：終極一戰
programme.desc: 患有胃病的葉問，於1949年隻身前往香港謀生在港九飯店職工總會天台開始教授詠春的他，獲得了一班新收徒弟這班徒弟中，任職警察的鄧聲因鎮壓罷工的工人，被逼著與同門師弟妹梁雙李瓊陳四妹等人為敵葉問的妻子張永成，在這期間從佛山來港團聚，未料香港的生活讓夫妻倆的相守之路越陷艱難

programme.title: 白髮魔女傳
programme.desc: 武當奇才卓一航幼年結識一神秘狼女成年後的卓一航為人正直，仗義行俠卻屢遭所指大師姐雖對其傾心，他卻毫不動心後因誤入魔教禁地為長髮少女所救而難忘其倩影而欲一統江湖的魔教姬無雙，被同屬魔教的練霓裳所制伏，卓一航在混戰中發覺練霓裳正是當年救他一命的長髮少女，兩情相悅互許終身但武當長老囑卓一航應以大局為重，要練霓裳離去，練霓裳因心傷導致烏髮瞬間全白，正邪終不兩立

programme.title: 新封神榜：楊戩
programme.desc: 商周之戰一千五百年後，天界衰落，蒙冤落魄的二郎神楊戩被迫封印天眼神通，只能以賞銀捕手為業謀生某日，一名神秘女子婉羅突然來訪，委託楊戩追捕一名竊取法寶的少年，而這名少年竟是楊戩許久未見的的親外甥沉香沉香立志尋回寶蓮燈以拯救被壓在華山蓮花峰下的母親，卻不知此舉將會釋放被鎮壓的滅世玄鳥，為天下蒼生帶來毀天滅地的災禍多方勢力紛紛現身插手，楊戩為了阻止沉香，竟意外揭開那塵封已久的秘密

programme.title: 危城
programme.desc: 民國初年，時值中國內戰軍閥割據亂世時代，一個叫普城的偏遠城鎮，其治安由普城保衛團暫管由於軍閥少帥曹少璘（古天樂飾）殺害三條人命，普城保衛團團長楊克難（劉青雲飾）於是將曹少帥繩之於法，然曹軍財雄勢大，以強權震懾居民，曹軍上校張亦（吳京飾）得悉事件後，趕來普城取人，遇上多年不見之浪人師弟馬鋒（彭于晏飾）馬鋒路見不平欲拔刀相助，卻面臨正義與兄弟情之抉擇

programme.title: 速命道
programme.desc: 開著救護車的小樂曾經是最佳賽車手，卻一場與哥哥阿杰的比試中，讓哥哥意外身亡，因而自暴自棄，直到遇見女醫生慧慧，轉念成為救護車司機，誓言要用速度救人然而一名神秘賽車手地獄貓的主人突然現身，他手握名冊，被挑戰的賽車手最終必然喪命地下賽車，就是一場現代武林，儘管以生命作為代價，仍無法阻擋狂熱者對速度進行宿命般的追逐

programme.title: 一眉道人
programme.desc: 一眉道人擅長茅山道術，和徒弟阿豪與一隻小殭屍住在一個小鎮上鄰鎮瘟疫蔓延，不時有殭屍出沒，一眉道人帶徒弟與小殭屍前去抓鬼，發現鄰鎮的飲用水源都被屍毒污染，在教堂地下室發現了殭屍的痕跡原來此處一具西洋殭屍意外復活，一場中國法術對付西洋殭屍的精彩好戲於焉上演

programme.title: 哮天神犬勇闖龍宮
programme.desc: 哮天犬因救龍王，三太子有功，得到龍王贈予龍珠，化為人形的哮天犬生性善良，誤中貓妖的詭計被其逃出天牢玉帝震怒，問責哮天犬的同時將其貶入人間

programme.title: 曼谷鬥犬
programme.desc: 特務姜德魯姜被派往泰國，展開一項極度危險的臥底任務，目標是摧毀由殘暴的犯罪頭目多米尼克梅西亞斯操控的人口販賣組織憑藉敏銳的街頭智慧和精湛的格鬥技巧，他很快贏得當地黑幫的信任，在曼谷黑道中迅速崛起然而，隨著他逐步逼近真相，他也漸漸迷失在這場危險的雙重生活中

programme.title: 聖誕玫瑰
programme.desc: 下肢癱瘓的李靜是名醫周文瑄女兒的鋼琴老師李靜指控周文瑄在一次內診時性侵她，與自稱清白的周文瑄對簿公堂，周妻徐潔因媒體未審先判飽受煎熬，又忙著為丈夫找律師和出庭作證這起司法對決掀起人性與正義角力的羅生門，隨著一場場針鋒相對的辯論，浮出水面的真相竟遠不只是一起以愛為名的悲劇

programme.title: 恐怖攻擊直播
programme.desc: 一位剛被降職而轉為主持廣播節目的主播尹榮華，某天接到不知名聽眾callin，恐嚇要脅若不回答問題或是掛電話，他將炸掉大橋，原以為只是無聊民眾的玩笑，沒想到就在掛掉電話後，他就親眼看見辦公大樓旁的跨海大橋遭到炸毀，該起恐怖攻擊造成無數傷亡！尹榮華意識到極可能是最近的連環爆炸事件主謀所為，於是緊急和電視台協議獨家直播該起爆炸案，企圖藉機讓自己重拾主播工作但接下來的直播過程卻漸漸開始失控

programme.title: 第一爐香
programme.desc: 上海女學生葛薇龍（馬思純飾）來香港求學，投靠姑媽梁太太（俞飛鴻飾），卻反被梁太太利用，將她當作誘餌吸引男人，葛薇龍漸漸沉溺在紙醉金迷中後來她被花花公子喬琪喬（彭于晏飾）吸引，為求繼續聲色犬馬的上流社會生活，不惜出賣自己的靈魂，費盡心機嫁給了喬琪喬，然最終卻淪為姑媽梁太太和喬琪喬斂財的工具

programme.title: 神話
programme.desc: 秦朝玉漱公主頻頻入夢，困擾著考古學家杰克，使他更醉心研究秦朝古物為解開夢境之謎，杰克來到西安的懸浮天宮，同時亦有各路高手為奪寶而來，天宮寶物被撬開，天空之城因而失去懸浮能力，成千上萬的兵馬俑從天而降，杰克受一股神秘力量牽引跳入萬丈瀑布睜開雙眼，出現的竟然是夢中人玉漱公主！

programme.title: 八星報喜
programme.desc: 一次電話線故障，促成方氏三兄弟的三段姻緣大哥方劍輝（黃百鳴飾）品性敦厚，與失婚婦人吳芬芳（馮寶寶飾）由冤家發展成戀人；天性風流的二哥方劍郎（周潤發飾）瞞著女友飄紅（鄭裕玲飾），與熱情如火的美麗（鍾楚紅飾）迅即擦出火花；三弟方劍笙（張學友飾）性格害羞，與在公園邂逅的開朗少女瑩瑩（袁潔瑩飾）萌芽出一段細水長流的純潔愛情三段姻緣來得意外，結局卻各有不同

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: 吳家大子吳理（呂方飾）對性感的麥當娜（李麗珍飾）朝思暮想，二女吳采（羅美薇飾）則借故親近表哥強（陳百強飾），小女兒吳姿（關佩琳飾）因小泰龍（柯有倫飾）一次相救而心生傾慕而吳太太（馮寶寶飾）不甘只當家庭主婦，決定參加話劇演員招考，並奇蹟入選劇團女主角，此時，劇團導演（樓南光飾）又對吳太展開追求，讓吳福基醋意大發話劇上映當日，吳家全體竟把話劇台詞當真，引起一陣風波

programme.title: 暗戰
programme.desc: 劉德華在片中飾演罹患癌症只剩下4星期生命的華，劉青雲則是飾演警察談判組談判專家何尚生，兩人展開了一場72小時鬥智鬥膽的遊戲杜琪峯以其最擅長的警匪片手法執導劉德華憑藉這部電影拿下個人第一座香港電影金像獎最佳男主角獎

programme.title: 一天首
programme.desc: 兩個男人，他們心愛的人死去的那一天不斷重複上演，他們決心聯手解決隱藏在時間迴圈中的秘密醫生俊英為了從車禍中救回女兒，拼命尋找改變那一天的方法，卻發現另一個男人民哲也一樣想要改變結局，救回死於意外的妻子隨著一名自稱兇手的神秘男子現身，他們驚覺這起事故並非普通意外，背後隱藏更黑暗的真相

programme.title: 死亡突擊
programme.desc: 緝毒局探員詹姆士在一項任務之後罹患了創傷壓力症候群，讓他產生分不清真假的幻覺，狀況愈來愈嚴重，小女兒珍送了一張度假小屋的招待卷給爸媽做為二度蜜月的禮物，就在詹姆士與妻子開往小屋的路上，珍就迫不及待地找同學來家裡開派對，乖巧的大女兒娜塔莉只好躲在房間，無意間在房間地板下面找到了一大筆錢，而此時有一群搶匪打算破門而入

programme.title: 微光殺機
programme.desc: 身為法醫的她一向對兇案現場暸若指掌，但這次的現場證據卻讓真相愈發模糊，死者隨著時間流逝快速增加，所有線索均指向兇手擁有人體組織而其他部分則非有機物質

programme.title: 舞力決戰
programme.desc: 街頭舞者安東夢想征服街舞世界，但一次嚴重的意外導致夢想粉碎，將他推進無聲世界失聰後的安東曾失去活下去的意義，直到他學會傾聽來自內心的樂音，開始教同樣失聰的小孩跳舞，成為他新的人生使命他開發出新的獨門舞步，冒險帶領這群小孩參加俄羅斯錦標賽，贏得世界冠軍賽的參賽資格

programme.title: 騙局
programme.desc: 安端羅卡是一位家族企業的老闆，因經營不善而申請破產，但無意中得知公司未用罄的碳排放量配額可以變現！這讓他想出了一個點子：成立空殼公司透過稅法漏洞進行碳排放量配額買賣，進而賺取消費稅差額這個歪主意雖然讓他大筆進帳，並順利買回破產的公司，卻也為他和周遭的好友們引來一連串殺身之禍

programme.title: 獵殺侏儸紀
programme.desc: 2030年第三次世界大戰期間，一群倖存者逃入一座地下碉堡兩年後，他們必須離開碉堡找尋補給，但隨之而來的卻是恐龍的獵殺

programme.title: 1915廓爾喀傳奇：勇敢之心
programme.desc: 本片啟發自步槍兵庫爾比爾塔帕的真實故事，是一部心理戰爭片一名毫無經驗的士兵，在戰爭中展開了奇蹟般的旅程，最終成為歷史上首位獲得維多利亞十字勳章的尼泊爾廓爾喀人，這是英聯邦軍隊在面對敵人時英勇表現的最高獎項

programme.title: 神鬼二勢力
programme.desc: 兩位出沒於墨西哥的辣妹俠盜以銀行為目標，劫富濟貧頻頻得手，成為家喻戶曉的傳奇而她們真正的敵人，其實是已將魔爪漸漸深入小鎮的邪惡勢力！

programme.title: 非法地帶
programme.desc: 為了紀念父親而登山的夏儂（傑米金飾演）無意間撞見當地警察的違法勾當，這些警察不僅介入毒品交易，甚至不惜殺人滅口夏儂將犯罪過程拍了下來，卻被當場發現，一場驚心動魄的追逐就此展開而身經百戰的資深警察傑克（布魯斯威利飾演）也恰巧捲入這場衝突，他將不惜一切代價聲張正義，將罪犯繩之以法

programme.title: 波伽利：聲命之歌
programme.desc: 阿莫斯生來就擁有美妙嗓音，卻因為先天性眼疾進入盲人學校，之後又在一場足球比賽意外後完全失明個性好強的他，卻從未因此放棄自己對音樂的熱情與夢想在恩師（安東尼奧班德拉斯飾）的嚴厲指導下，他的歌唱技巧不斷提升與突破，終於獲得義大利國寶級搖滾明星蘇奇洛賞識，親自邀他同台獻唱，此後開始朝史上最成功的跨界男高音之路邁進

programme.title: 311：東京大震盪
programme.desc: 2011年3月11日，日本遭遇史上最大地震的襲擊，引發福島海嘯災難亞歷珊卓拉剛從法國來到東京，正準備在當地法商銀行工作，卻突然遭逢這場核災危機在工作與家庭間拉扯，逐漸浮現的恐懼與焦慮就要吞噬亞歷珊卓拉離開或者留下，丈夫兒女與仰賴她的員工，亞歷珊卓拉該如何抉擇？

programme.title: 黑豹救援軍
programme.desc: 二戰期間，喬治巴頓將軍帶領著他的第三支美軍一路越過法國邊境，殺進納粹德國希特勒為了攔阻敵軍前進，出動了秘密武器Me262戰鬥機一場空中大戰隨即展開弗蘭克羅斯中尉駕駛著這場空戰的其中一架美軍戰機，眼看已敵不過納粹的猛烈襲擊，只好迫降在敵軍陣地內，在等待援兵的同時，非裔駕駛坦克前來營救為了贏得這場戰爭，他們必須將種族差異擱置一邊

programme.title: 戰爭中的鬼故事
programme.desc: 在二次世界大戰最黑暗的日子裡，五名美國大兵受命前往一座曾被納粹高級指揮官佔領的法國莊園當他們進入這座莊園後，竟開始經歷一連串難以解釋的靈異現象，讓他們的世界變得瘋狂這場難以脫逃的夢魘，似乎比戰爭所目睹事物都更加可怕

programme.title: 赤色追緝令
programme.desc: 寧靜的阿爾卑斯山大學社區裡，發生男子遭絞殺的屍體高懸在山崖上的案件，詭異的是當地人卻對此事不聞不問探員皮埃爾經過調查後，發現這所學校隱藏著不為人知的秘密，懷疑是經過縝密安排後的謀殺案件同時間，數百里外則發生女童墓園遭入侵案件，年輕警探麥斯深入追查後，發現該女童來自歌隆鎮神秘線索將皮埃爾與麥斯繫在一起，他們抽絲剝繭追查這冰封多年的秘密，揮之不去的死亡陰影卻如影隨形

programme.title: 天怒
programme.desc: 一位少年目睹親生哥哥遭南方犯罪集團所殺，而當一名危險的殺手接到暗殺少年的任務時，他過去腥風血雨的世界竟有了救贖的希望在葬禮舉行前的數小時，這名殺手必須在對手以及聯邦調查局行動之前，搶先一步找到少年；但隨著時間一點一滴流逝，這名殺手開始質疑自己的殘忍手段，在最後一刻他必須作出選擇

programme.title: 聖保羅大劫案
programme.desc: 擁有龐大勢力的黑幫老大魯本斯，決定在養女莉歐妮亞的協助下，最後再大幹一票但在聖保羅的銀行搶劫行動中，出乎意料的情況發生了，魯本斯和莉歐妮亞在巴拉圭銷贓後，兩人陷入了危機本片改編自真實事件

programme.title: 超市撿到槍
programme.desc: 當百無聊賴的進化論哲學家馬丁莫羅意外捲入一場搶劫時，他無意中撿到了凶器馬丁開始對生活有了新的渴望，他決定保留這把槍男孩和槍之間展開了真正的浪漫，但這件事並非沒有後果

programme.title: 花生醬獵鷹的願望
programme.desc: 患有唐氏症的查克夢想成為摔角手，他不顧一切逃離照護機構，只為了找到崇拜的傳奇摔角手，向他拜師學藝查克在路上結識了正在逃避仇家的亡命之徒泰勒，為了尋找查克而心急如焚的看護艾莉諾也隨後趕至堅毅的生存者遇見不黯世故的純真靈魂，駕起一葉扁舟，他們在逐夢途上碰撞出愛與友誼的火花

programme.title: 闊少遇難記
programme.desc: 闊少圭格里從小過著為所欲為的生活，終於有一天胡鬧過頭即將面臨牢獄之災，他的父親決定給他教訓，將一座廢棄的村莊改建成19世紀的模樣，刻意安排一場假車禍，讓圭格里以為他穿越到過去，一個複雜的心理實驗就此展開被寵壞的富二代轉世成為農奴，集結大批臨演的村莊架滿監視器並由一組心理學家嚴密審視而圭格里在尋找自我的同時，也找到了真愛

programme.title: 絕命3小時
programme.desc: 曾是歷史地標的堡高醫院，荒廢已久並面臨即將拆除的命運，但某幫派卻在此藏了九千萬，隨著消息傳開，兩個敵對黑幫虎視眈眈，想要找出這筆贓款，未料卻被拆除工人麥可搶先發現，而距離建物爆破拆除期限僅剩短短三小時

programme.title: 復仇殺神
programme.desc: 前海軍陸戰隊成員麥斯回家發現老婆和身為FBI探員的哥哥被殘忍地謀殺，而他的寶貝女兒也不知去向，這突如其來的衝擊讓麥斯陷入極度的悲慟，警方開始調查整件命案的緣由，但麥斯不想就這樣交由警方處理，深陷悲傷和仇恨的他決定自己展開行動，找回女兒，但也因為這樣讓他越陷越深，這將會是一場血腥暴力的復仇之路

programme.title: 前線狙擊手
programme.desc: 1943年末，納粹派出訓練有素的狙擊手進入到前線，帶來了破壞和死亡，被圍困的蘇聯士兵已經堅守保衛了國家兩年年輕又天賦異稟的獵人葉戈爾受到徵召挺身對抗入侵者，雖然年輕又缺乏戰鬥經驗，葉戈爾仍以過人的技能和勇氣，證明自己在前線有能力扮演扭轉戰局至關重要的角色

programme.title: 北極戰隊
programme.desc: 北極狐史威帝在北極物流公司的收發室工作，但他有著遠大的夢想：希望有朝一日能成為頂尖的北極快遞員為了證明自己的能耐，史威帝自告奮勇運送一批神秘貨物，卻意外發現海象奧托的邪惡計畫，他與手下們打算釋放地底下的古代氣體，讓北極完全融化史威帝與他的好友們組成一支臨時戰隊，要阻止奧托的可怕陰謀！

programme.title: 瞞天機密
programme.desc: 在英國情報機構任職的中文翻譯員凱薩琳，某天收到一封讓她備感震驚的電子郵件，內容顯示美國國安局為使聯合國安理會同意發動伊拉克戰爭，竟串通英國政府執行非法行動，企圖改變聯合國表決結果凱薩琳向媒體揭發此事，成功引發世界輿論的關注與譴責在此同時，她也因為違反國家機密法而遭控叛國罪她該如何對抗這個不公不義的政府？而這個世界又將如何回應她的勇氣呢？

programme.title: 普羅旺斯的夏天
programme.desc: 住在巴黎的三兄妹莉雅安德里和天生失聰的小弟泰歐，被媽媽送到普羅旺斯的外公家過暑假對三兄妹來說外公是個陌生人，既古板又頑固，普羅旺斯和巴黎截然不同的氛圍也讓他們感到格格不入儘管爺孫們在爭執中逐漸感受到彼此的在乎，卻沒想到一次衝突後莉雅憤而離家出走，這個瘋狂的暑假會如何結束呢？

programme.title: 終結戰
programme.desc: 一位項上人頭遭到懸賞的年輕美國警察為了替亡師報仇血恨，與一名泰國傭兵聯手合作當他發現自己正與該國最惡名昭彰的冷酷罪犯正面交峰時，他的任務轉瞬之間變得無比凶險

programme.title: 警網鐵金剛
programme.desc: 政客查莫斯為了政治利益，準備於舊金山參議院小組委員聽證會上，舉發芝加哥黑幫組織為求污點證人羅斯能安全出庭，臨時由舊金山警局小隊長布利特保護然而黑幫殺手似乎對其行程瞭若指掌，一路由旅館追殺至醫院，造成同仁重傷證人死亡原本單純的證人保護行動竟發展至此，布利特必須在聽證會開庭前僅餘的短短一天時間內，在有限線索下解開這疑雲重重的謎團

programme.title: 十兄弟
programme.desc: 大蝦夫婦因緣際會下，發現父親留給他們的一塊脊田原來是塊寶地，內藏寶珠十粒寶珠有神奇力量，可以呼風喚雨，隨心所欲這事被無惡不作的大帥得知後，帶兵到大蝦家搶寶珠，混亂中，大蝦和大蝦嫂各吞下五粒寶珠，分頭逃走了當天晚上，雷電交錯，大蝦和大蝦嫂同時生下了五個孩子，這十個孩子都擁有不同的特異功能

programme.title: 巴頓將軍
programme.desc: 二戰中期，當德軍元帥沙漠之狐隆美爾橫掃北非之際，為了扭轉局勢，美方指派巴頓接任英美聯軍的美軍指揮官這位治軍嚴謹特立獨行的將軍，一舉將隆美爾趕出北非，造成德國極大的震撼；然而巴頓藐視命令為求勝仗不顧部下死活的行事風格，在日後的西西里戰役造成盟軍極大傷亡才獲得慘勝，隨即遭到解職然爾後戰事逆轉，盟軍統帥艾森豪只得再次啟用這位德軍剋星重返戰場，解救友軍直搗柏林

programme.title: 庖丁傳奇之金刀御廚
programme.desc: 民以食為天，八大菜系中佛跳牆之由來有各種傳説，本故事即以兩位廚師及其後人經歷各種磨難，涅槃重生，創造此經典閩菜之過程

programme.title: 偷龍轉鳳
programme.desc: 妮可是巴黎著名的邦尼家族千金，但邦尼家族私下係以偽造名家藝術贗品為樂巴黎一所博物館將舉行藝術品展覽，妮可的父親受邀參加，然而其中被視為偉大傑作的維納斯雕像，其實是她祖父製造的贗品，投保一百萬美元不料，保險公司要求技術鑑定，眼看事蹟即將敗露，妮可只得聘請一位高明神偷賽門偷走雕像

programme.title: 唐山大兄
programme.desc: 青年華僑鄭潮安（李小龍 飾）被母親送往泰國的一間冰廠做苦工謀生；冰廠東主沙密外表為紳士巨富，實為一包娼庇賭之大惡霸在遭受迫害多時後，忍無可忍的鄭潮安與沙密展開生死決鬥，當地政府為紀念鄭潮安為地方除害伸張正義，在公園豎立了銅像，名曰：唐山大兄

programme.title: 哥吉拉對黑多拉
programme.desc: 日本駿河灣接連發生不明物體撞沉船隻事件而漁民在此都捕不到漁獲，海洋生物學家矢野教授受託前往海灣調查，卻遭到怪物襲擊矢野教授檢測檢體發現禍源乃是一種以汙染物為食的無機外星生物，這狀似蝌蚪的泥漿獸被稱為黑多拉不久黑多拉上岸肆虐，感應到威脅的哥吉拉適時出現，地球的命運將會如何呢？

programme.title: 我出去醫下
programme.desc: 前無國界醫生賽吉是唯一一位會在聖誕夜出診的醫生，他跟美食外送員馬利克發生了車禍雖然被撞的是馬利克，但卻引發了賽吉的坐骨神經痛，情急之下，馬利克只好代替賽吉登門看診於是他戴上AirPods，透過賽吉的隔空電話指導，搖身一變成為超瞎醫生！

programme.title: 江湖女間諜
programme.desc: 來自愛爾蘭的瑪麗亞一號，從小隨著革命家父親為反對英國統治而四處進行破壞一次行動中父親不幸喪命，她誤打誤撞躲藏在馬戲團，遇到法國來的瑪麗亞二號為了幫她逃避英軍追捕，兩個瑪麗亞結成表演組合，因大膽表演迅速爆紅一次表演後，瑪麗亞二號邂逅了革命首腦弗洛雷斯並為其偉大情操打動，但弗洛雷斯卻不幸被獨裁者追捕射殺，瑪麗亞二號便繼承其遺志，號召村民展開抗爭，瑪麗亞一號也憑多年經驗來幫助平民百姓

programme.title: 以愛之名：翁山蘇姬
programme.desc: 1988年，翁山蘇姬從英國牛津回到緬甸探望病危的母親，適逢緬甸爆發反政府運動，爭取民主改革之聲不絕於耳，翁山蘇姬創立的全國民主聯盟，迅速成為全國最大反對黨，對軍政府造成極大威脅翌年，軍政府以煽動騷亂罪名將翁山蘇姬軟禁，她拒絕以驅逐出境來換取自由的條件，從此與心愛的丈夫麥可及兩名兒子別離

programme.title: 大進擊
programme.desc: 二戰期間，英國轟炸中隊於巴黎上空執行轟炸任務，其中一架轟炸機被德軍擊中，飛行員被迫跳傘逃生，並約好在清真寺旁的土耳其浴室會合其中三名英軍分別降落在動物園水池歌劇院，以及正在重新粉刷的納粹祕密警察總部屋頂，在動物園管理員歌劇院樂團指揮與油漆工幫助下逃生而樂團指揮和油漆工，更陰錯陽差隨著三名英軍飛行員，與德軍展開了一場場驚險刺激的逃亡之旅！

programme.title: 最好的我們
programme.desc: 一張舊照片，映入了攝影師耿耿的眼簾觸動了當年回憶的開關在那個恣意揮灑的青春年代裡，耿耿和資優生余淮成了鄰座校園內充斥著少男少女們懵懂青澀的賀爾蒙耿耿和余淮也不例外，兩人相約高考後再相見，但當耿耿滿懷期待前往約定之地，余淮卻像人間蒸發般渺無音訊當年余淮懸在嘴邊未說出的話那不辭而別的秘密，到底是什麼？

programme.title: 馴悍記
programme.desc: 富商巴提斯塔有個頭痛的問題，小女兒碧安卡乖巧柔順，總有一堆名流前來提親；但前提是須讓性格乖僻暴躁的大女兒凱特麗娜先行出嫁看似瘋癲輕薄的沒落貴族彼特魯喬，聽聞凱特麗娜有豐厚嫁妝而前往追求，於是這對瘋癲無賴與火爆千金，在心不甘情不願的情況下結了婚雙方從鬥力到鬥智，最終將是彼特魯喬馴服了悍婆還是凱特麗娜駕馭了莽夫？

programme.title: 龍爭虎鬥
programme.desc: 少林高僧有兩名天份過人之弟子，長徒韓（石堅 飾）已背叛師門專作不法勾當，幼徒李（李小龍 飾）受到師傅委託，參加比武大會，師兄弟在一場龍爭虎鬥之後，韓倒在一長茅尖端上，了結一生罪惡

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記完
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 惜花芷
programme.desc: 世家千金經商勇敢為家族撐出一片天，張婧儀攜手胡一天立下終身之約！！京城望族花府忽遭抄家流放，被拆散的家族只徒留老弱婦孺守家門花家長女花芷從不過問家中世事，出面嶄露經商鋒芒撐起家中生計，帶著眾女重返家族光榮原以為自己不好惹的名聲傳遍京城將孤獨一生，遇見了七宿司司使顧晏惜成為彼此的救贖也向她許諾終身

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版新
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 八年愛情遇上現實 婚後生活秒變修羅場劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房沒車沒鑽戒沒婚禮的裸婚兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 夫婦的世界升級版！初戀女神現身 揭開五人幫隱藏面具一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學五人幫維持二十年的體面假象死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失嫉妒的丈夫被逼到絕境的妻子病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.desc: 八年愛情遇上現實 婚後生活秒變修羅場劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房沒車沒鑽戒沒婚禮的裸婚兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 倩女幽魂:人間情普

programme.title: 搏命單刀奪命槍粵普
programme.desc: 刀王和槍王的武功不相伯仲,於是各自收徒傳授武學,圖比高低.十五年前他們手下敗將捲土重來,武功突飛猛進,刀王槍王俱斃命其大刀下.徒弟們為師復仇後,竟承繼並師鬥氣本色,比試又再開始.

programme.title: 鍾無艷粵
programme.desc: 齊宣王誤闖夜叉山,碰巧撞上了風姿綽約的寨主鍾無艷,二人一見鍾情.鍾情於鍾無艷的狐狸精被拒愛,於是向無艷施愛情咒,使其臉上忽然多了塊大痣,把齊宣王嚇得拔腿而逃,二人感情從此障礙重重.狐狸精化身為美女夏迎春去勾引齊王,忽男忽女的她竟同時愛上齊王和無艷,硬是周旋在二人之間.齊王被狐狸精的美色所誘,但無艷仍對齊王痴心一片,甘為齊王南征北戰,衝鋒陷陣,出生入死.無艷在迎春多番打擊下多次入冷宮,坐天...

programme.title: 英雄本色粵
programme.desc: 宋子豪狄龍飾與李馬克Mark,周潤發飾是國際偽鈔集團重要人物,彼此情如手足.子豪的弟弟宋子杰張國榮飾剛剛考入警察訓練學校,女友鍾柔朱寶意飾對他情深一片.一次,宋子豪帶手下譚成李子雄飾去台灣與當地黑幫作偽鈔交易,卻遭譚成出賣,子豪最後向台灣警方自首,入獄三年.Mark得悉子豪被捕,孤身一人赴台為子豪報仇,卻不幸中槍成了跛子,從此在幫會地位一落千丈.與此同時,台灣黑幫唯恐子豪...

programme.title: 天才與白痴粵普
programme.desc: 白痴仔心地善良,活得無憂無慮,但命運要他變成神童,名與利滾滾而來,金錢物慾的背後卻活得空虛.命運又再一次向他開玩笑,神童即將變回白痴,得與失只有他自己心知.

programme.title: 龍的傳人粵
programme.desc: 周飛鴻元華 飾是大嶼山大澳村的武術教頭,性格剛直其子周小龍周星馳 飾自幼受父親薰陶也是正直純潔的年輕人,平日與師妹毛毛毛舜筠 飾一同習武,亦是對歡喜冤家.某日,小龍的師叔毛仁梁家仁 飾從都市前來躲避賭債,受到周家父子的熱情款待,並無意中發現小龍的桌球天份順周飛鴻托兒見世面之便,毛仁將小龍帶到香港發展,且利用他進行賭博活動.小龍在不知不覺中,已替毛仁賺了不少,生活也變得...

programme.title: 阿二一族粵
programme.desc: DODO是深圳某對外貿易發展公司代表,泰沛是港商某內衣胸圍底褲廠老闆,因內地設廠關係相識DODO.DODO來港了解工廠生產設備,操作程序,人事管理,吸取經驗,暫時入住了沛前度情婦的住所,華是沛的得力助手,理所當然對DODO悉心照料...

programme.title: 大武當粵普
programme.desc: 初期,相傳武當山有稀世寶藏,百年輪回一次的武林盛會即將開戰,各路高手齊聚道教聖地武當山爭當天下第一. 民國,神秘女子使絕招搶奪大會戰貼加入戰局,表面上以武會友,背裡卻為一樁家族使命,而考古教授帶著自幼習武的女兒,為傳說中的鎮山之寶混入武當...

programme.title: 激戰粵普
programme.desc: 香港過氣西洋拳王程輝年輕時為了錢而幫對手打假拳,跟他的師傅因此決裂,事情被查出後還因此入獄幾年.出獄後,拳壇沒落的他做起的士司機,如今淪落成身負二十幾萬賭債的落魄中年.他為了躲債而跑到澳門謀生,靠跟他關係不錯的師兄楊慶新找到健身中心的工作來賺錢還債.程輝入住一間由王明君和梁佩丹母女倆擁有的合租房,觀察到明君時常受精神病困擾.小丹講述她爸爸四年前棄家跑掉而讓家庭支離破碎,連她弟弟也不幸遇溺死亡...

programme.title: 龍在邊緣粵普
programme.desc: 以迫已轉正行飛龍重出江湖,但卻被飛龍拒絕,豹的 兒子文俊譚耀文演為人心狠手辣,趁機以報仇為明,同眾叔父提出先找出二五仔再殺高SIR,再殺高大衰:而成得知想通知白頭文時...

programme.title: 救殭清道夫粵

programme.desc: The Go Jetters swing into action when Glitch uses real landmarks for his crazy golf course.

programme.title: The Nazca Lines, Peru
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to protect ancient artwork in Peru, when Glitch erases the Nazca Lines.

programme.title: Thomas Animal Friends
programme.desc: Thomas is asked to dress up as a monkey for a special event at the Animal Park, but all the other engines laugh at him. Luckily, Rebecca is on hand to offer some useful advice.

programme.title: Balloon Barnacles
programme.desc: Sarahs hat goes on an adventure without her, on top of a balloon.

programme.title: Basking Shark
programme.desc: Sarah is keen to adopt a sea creature, but doesnt get her first choice...

programme.title: Dinosaur
programme.desc: The children want to make a big dinosaur model so they can learn all about it. They make such a huge dinosaur that they want to take it to the museum to be shown as an exhibit.

programme.title: Kite
programme.desc: Stanley helps Little Woo and Seamus fly their new kite. It gets stuck up a tree and breaks. Using leaves and sticks, they build a better one, only for that to get stuck.

programme.title: Penguins Live in Igloos
programme.desc: Rain, hail, sunshine, and making snow giraffes! The animals chat about everything they love about their favourite seasons.

programme.title: Its time to find a butterfly
programme.desc: JoJo searches for a butterfly to complete her nature tick-book. She learns that all butterflies start life as furry little caterpillars.

programme.title: Rain
programme.desc: When a heavy summer rain thunders over the Heeler home, Bluey is determined to dam the water in the front yard, while Mum tries to stop her constantly tracking mud into the house.

programme.title: Pizza Girls
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo make mud pizzas and deliver them to the grown-ups, but their pedal cars wheel keeps falling off.

programme.title: Driving
programme.desc: With only five minutes to play Driving, Bluey and Mum race against the clock to buy milk for a grumpy guest and have to escape an angry shopkeeper.

programme.title: The Footprint Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are playing hide-and-seek, but they cant find Happy. The squirrels follow lots of different footprints that take them to their friend but there is one set they cant work out.

programme.title: The Juice Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is going to make the squirrels juice from the garden. Whilst picking the fruit, the squirrels meet a little bug, full of woes about being too small.

programme.title: The Whistling Badge
programme.desc: When Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise? A whistle? The squirrels want to learn how to whistle.

programme.title: The Boreal Forest, Canada
programme.desc: Glitch travels to Ontario to find a new teddy bear, but things start to go very wrong...

programme.title: Parsnip
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its Parsnip performing a jaw dropping escape that will leave even Houdini speechless.

programme.title: Spinach
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, its the exceptional painter, Spinach, creating Kiwis portrait, if Kiwi can keep still.

programme.title: The Golden Snuggybear
programme.desc: Supertato helps Tomato get a rare toy for his museum from a giant toy capsule vending machine, but Evil Pea traps them inside and takes it for herself!

programme.title: Poor Little Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea plans to break the Tatoscope by pretending shes hurt her foot and getting Supertato to invite her into Tato Tower to recover.

programme.title: Listen
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po take it in turns to listen to music through a pair of headphones. The Teletubbies love dancing to the music they hear.

programme.title: Feet
programme.desc: Yakka Dee! celebrates children communicating - because talking fills you up with whizz, pop, bang! In this episode, Dee encourages a friend to say feet and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different feet. There are little feet and big feet, tiptoeing feet and jumping feet. We see a little duckling with webbed feet, some tickly feet and even some jelly feet! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dees friend finally

programme.title: Hiccups
programme.desc: Messys hiccups cause a landslide while he is out on a nature walk. Will he be able to find his way home? And will he ever stop hiccupping?

programme.title: Pig Gets Big
programme.desc: Farmer Jackson was just trying to grow some giant tomatoes, but he wound up with a giant pig! Now, Mojo and Bo have to get Felix back to normal size before Swoppiton gets stomped.

programme.title: Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... hes just entered Ragdoll mode!

programme.title: Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin wont give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: The Good Choices
programme.desc: The Squirrels havent been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggees help, they start to get it right. But not before sending Rolys imagination into overdrive!

programme.title: The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When theyre accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: Whats that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? Its the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Solar E-Glitch
programme.desc: After watching a solar eclipse, the team head into space to fix the biggest glitch yet!

programme.title: Bike
programme.desc: Bluey is struggling to learn how to ride her bike. But as she and Dad watch her friends determination with their own tasks, Bluey is inspired to give it another try.

programme.title: Seesaw
programme.desc: Dad has rudely plonked himself on one end of the seesaw. So Bluey and Bingo round up the entire playground to help flip him off, but they still need to find one more friend.

programme.title: The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Luckys family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: Andy and the Alamosaurus
programme.desc: Jen is carried away by a weather balloon and Andy sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to rescue her. Along the way, they meet the mighty Alamosaurus.

programme.title: Sponge
programme.desc: Bella and Lift have fun playing with sponges, and so does Tincy the Spider in the Sing Song Forest - just watch out for those soapy bubbles!

programme.title: The Nature Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels can learn more about nature and wildlife if they follow five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, dont interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet.

programme.title: The Dos and Donts Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess in the clubhouse, so Duggee explains that they need to think more carefully about what they are doing.

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop Sun Chien who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: Murder Plot
programme.desc: Martial artist Shen Lang is in discussions with kung fu experts from the other six sects to plot the downfall of the traitorous Happy King when his fiancee suddenly disrupts them and Shen has to quickly bring her away. As they continue to pursue the Happy King, both Shen and his fiancee accidentally fall into a trap set up by the King.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friends grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called Swordswomen Two. Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaws first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Mulan disguises herself as a male soldier to replace her aged father in a war against the barbarians. Her courage brings her victory in battles and she was promoted to a general. When Mulan returns home with glory, the chief commander asks her to marry his daughter, forcing Mulan to reveal her true identity.

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperors tomb.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperors plot once again.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best. Its not so much the plot - a master swordsman protects a treasure chest on a dangerous journey - that makes this great, but what Sun does with it, inspiring the cast and crew to some of their finest

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaws sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the Jackie Chan style is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a drunken master for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brothers death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Two Con Men
programme.desc: Two Con Men is a wonderfully twisted, pseudo-romantic comedy in the vein of Robin Hood meets The Sting. Starring Liang Tien as Clever Chan and Chang Ying whos done over 400 films as Tricky Ching, its the age-old competition between a rookie con artist versus the ultimate, experienced flimflam man. Its a game Chen cannot afford to lose, because peoples lives - including his own, hang in the balance of good versus evil.

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Fu Hong Xue, a legendary swordsman, travels far to avenge his father, only to find the seven killers he tracks are already dead. Investigating with Yeh Kai, he learns they are alive, manipulated by disguise master Xiao Bie Li, who lures Fu into a trap. Yeh Kai aids him, but both end up trapped in a deadly blade formation.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: Famous Kung Fu Pole master Red Eagle, is kidnapped by a villain one day. His disciple Meng, vows to rescue him. On his way, Meng encounters a greedy but great martial artist who agrees to join him in the rescue. Even though the two have extremely different personalities, they manage to team up and fight the villain in a final showdown.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sisters wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolins Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hungs son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Fengs innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the films hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chens past insult.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tians daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Ruo Wei returns to her childhood home with two best friends, and reunites with her cousin who has always lived there. While they plan to enjoy their trip, they are constantly haunted by paranormal events, ending up in a terrifying experience with unexpected outcome.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: Detective Lin forms a special task force to crack down on violent motorbike robbers terrorising Foshan and expose the syndicate behind them. However, when his pregnant wife becomes a victim during a brutal attack, Lin uncovers a ruthless conspiracy driven by revenge, pushing him into a dangerous battle against criminals with nothing to lose.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kongs brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfathers fortune with one condition he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian and seek evidence against his gang. After their release, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, as Shan cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Casino Tycoon. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Feis possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: After uncovering his sister-in-law Pan Jin Lians affair with the corrupt Xi Men Qing, Wu Song is falsely accused and exiled. However, when his elder brother is murdered, Wu Song returns determined to seek justice. With the authorities refusing to punish the guilty, his fury drives him toward a bloody path of revenge.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Mans matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Confession of Pain
programme.desc: When the billionaire father-in-law of veteran homicide detective Hei is brutally murdered, Heis wife, doubting the police investigation, hires his former partner and close friend, private detective Bong, to uncover the truth. As the case takes unexpected twists, Bong discovers the murder is mysteriously linked to Hei.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xins ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggars gang when he saves the gangs elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Martial arts master Liang Kun withdraws from the jianghu to protect the woman he loves, but his absence leads to her tragic death. Realising he can no longer escape his fate, he returns to the martial world. With the help of beggar clan leader Su Can, Liang Kun fights his way through ruthless enemies to avenge her.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Final Justice 1988
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: The Toretto Virus
programme.desc: The team has shut down Sudarikovs base and are ready to celebrateunitil the base starts moving on its own. The Toretto AI takes control of the base and begins its mission to take over the world starting with infecting nearby Bangkok. Tony realizes that the only way to stop the virus is to engage in the ultimate battle: Toretto vs. Toretto.

programme.title: Incineration Day
programme.desc: The Spy Racers learn from Ms. Nowhere about Incineration Day, an agency holiday where spy tech is destroyed in a fun, safe, stress-relieving explosion. But when a mysterious figure steals the warehouse full of to be destroyed spy tech, the team heads to Europe to embark on their most dangerous mission yet.

programme.title: Phil Pickle
programme.desc: When Phils beloved stick companion Philliam goes missing, he enlists the help of Ugga and Eep who lead an investigation across the farm.

programme.title: Best Friend in Show
programme.desc: Each kid believes that they have the best pet on the farm, and hold a contest to prove it. Meanwhile, Phils attempts to find a pet to enter proves dangerous, as he turns to wild animals.

programme.title: Game Of Crows
programme.desc: The Croods and Bettermans take in Malachi, Grans longtime enemy, until his broken wing heals. Eep is unsure whether or not Malachi can be trusted.

programme.title: War of the Cheeks
programme.desc: Boss searches for evidence that Tabithas best friend is an Uncuddleable, but is sidetracked by a Templeton Family tradition: The War of the Cheeks, a Go Fish tournament where the winner gets to make family rules for a whole day. When Yvette joins in, Boss has to keep her from winning, out of fear that an evil babysitter will make family rules that overturn the Templeton household.

programme.title: Techy Tykes
programme.desc: Trying to win Tabithas loyalty for Baby Corp, Boss and Tina invite her to Techy Tykes, a technology convention at their office. But when the top-secret UBO goes missing, the outsiders Tabitha and Tim whos tagged along to relive his glory days immediately become the number one suspects.

programme.title: Birthday Blues

programme.title: Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: NIP CHI YUEN Ma Steven, who works in the anti-smuggling camp, is determined to wipe out the Taus Fort, which is the stronghold for salt smugglers. He pretends to be a down-and-out scholar. TAU SING SUET Yeung Yi, daughter of the chief smuggler, sympathizes with YUEN and puts him up in the village. Later, they even become fond of each other. During an anti-smuggling operation SUET is badly hurt and has since been separated from YUEN and her family. Fortunately she is saved by WU TING HIN Wo

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI Kent Cheng of the Con Eight is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG Kent Tong and his senior PONG FUNG Paul Chun. MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP Angie Cheong. Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI Choi Hon Yik and MAK KEI James Ng as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU Ada Wong. After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI Wong Pak Man, LUNG SEI believes his disciple

Xinmiao idolizes Mingtian, and the two are like

programme.title: 热烈One and Only

programme.title: 悟空传Wu Kong

programme.title: 红豆Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: 张家经营着位于九龙城的中式甜品店，然而母亲突发中风，令一家人陷入剧变女儿为了维持甜品店的生意，不得不放弃成为空姐的梦想，却在过程中与父亲产生冲突他们一家能否齐心协力，克服重重难关？

programme.title: 残影空间Shadows

programme.title: 想见你Someday or One Day

programme.title: 无间一战Endless Battle
programme.desc: 故事围绕着一对兄弟弟弟是贩毒集团的头目，哥哥健忠则是缉毒组探员，二人不约而同卷入一场毒枭的地盘斗争中一次，健忠在押送毒贩的过程中无意间发现弟弟隐藏着的真正身份一场无间反转的正邪交锋随即展开

programme.title: 我爱你!Love Never Ends

programme.title: 暗色天堂Heaven in the Dark
programme.desc: Michelle与杜牧师激情一吻后，到警署落案告杜牧师性骚扰，双方对簿公堂杜牧师最终选择远离宗教，遁入俗世，反之Michelle则更对宗教沉迷五年后二人重遇，才发现大家仍未将事情放下

programme.title: 阿龙Atonement

programme.title: 团圆饭Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: 朝阳和子虹终于到了谈婚论嫁的阶段，但未造访彼此家长在一次客户的要求下，他们俩必须在年除夕当晚与家人共享团圆饭，以直播方式来推销客户的产品可是朝阳和妈妈关系不好，长年不相往来，于是突发奇想请了一群演员来扮家人出席饭局本该喜气洋洋的聚会，却变得啼笑皆非！

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where its warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring?

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1

programme.title: 海峡两岸Across the Strait
programme.desc: 中央电视台唯一的涉台时事新闻评论栏目节目宗旨是跟踪海峡热点，反映两岸民意，节目分为两个版块：第一个是热点扫描，主要报道当日的近期台湾岛内的热点新闻；第二个是热点透视，当日或近期涉台热点深度报道及两岸专家对此事的评论，并对两岸各个层面的交流交往进行跟踪报道

programme.title: 中国新闻China News
programme.desc: 中国新闻是以海外华人华侨港澳台同胞留学生驻外使领馆及中资机构人员为目标受众的综合性新闻栏目能够覆盖全球各大时区的对外名牌电视栏目栏目由国内外要闻中国内地经济和社会新闻对国内外重要新闻事件的分析和评论组成

programme.title: 今日关注Focus Today
programme.desc: 今日关注紧密跟踪国内外重大新闻事件新闻话题，邀请国内外一流的专家和高级官员，梳理新闻来龙去脉，分析新闻背后的新闻，评论新闻事件的影响和发展趋势

programme.title: 走遍中国Around China
programme.desc: 主要以中国的某一城市（或地域或主题）为选题范围，选取其最具的历史传承风土人情杰出人物自然风光和发展变化以连续一周每天30分钟播出的大容量，向世界全景式地展现新世纪的中国城市（或地域）形象

programme.title: 新闻联播Network News
programme.desc: 新闻联播是中国中央电视台于1978年1月1日创办的综合性新闻节目该栏目由中央电视台牵头主办全国各省级电视台合办旨在囊括国内外要闻，宣传党和政府的路线方针政策，反映群众呼声，提供各种重要信息它的收视率雄居中央电视台各档节目的首位，是国内外观众群最庞大影响最广泛的电视新闻栏目

programme.title: 成为饭吧A Good Supper
programme.desc: 乡下小火车站周围有一家挂着饭店招牌的破旧白米饭店女高中生英信虽然是高三学生，但为了饭店的生意，骑着自行车每天急急忙忙地往市场跑，这是为了给来饭店解决一顿饭的客人准备一顿既便宜又温暖的晚餐英信从小就跟饭店老板京秀学做饮食后来饭店还来了跟着离婚的父亲，一夜之间开始了农村生活的正勋...被妈妈爸爸抛弃，被老奶奶养大的五福...还有双职工夫妇所以晚上主要在饭店吃饭的多情...这些同龄人从小时开始长达12年的晚上都聚集在饭店里吃同一桌饭，铸就了比亲兄弟更亲密的情感，比家人更紧密的联系

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 飞到我心上Blossom Through the Cloud
programme.desc: After her pilot dream is crushed by Fu Mingyus decision, flight attendant Ruan Sixian quits in humiliation. Three years later, she returns as a trained pilot forcing the man who once misjudged her to see her anew.

programme.title: 飞到我心上Blossom Through the Cloud
programme.desc: Fu Mingyu is determined to recruit a brilliant female pilot only to discover she is Ruan Sixian. To win her back to Shihang, he even makes the sun appear to rise in the west, reopening a fate neither expected.

programme.title: 逐玉Pursuit of Jade

programme.title: 逐玉Pursuit of Jade
programme.desc: Domestic warmth gives way to suspicion when Xie Zheng notices secrets in Changyus family blade. Then a murder accusation turns her fight to keep her home into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Gangs of Lemur Island Season 1

programme.title: Cub Camp Season 1

programme.title: Gladiators Season 1

programme.title: Gladiators Season 1
programme.desc: Go up against Australias wiliest gladiators and their impressive arsenals. Learn if these weapons, such as the kangaroos deadly boxing moves and the redback spiders precision-engineered traps, can help them survive the ravages of climate change.

programme.title: Uptown Otters Season 1

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where its warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring?

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror genre this extraordinary nature documentary takes you on a journey following a well-known hero with six legs, red wings and seven black dots through a seemingly normal meadow but full of monsters.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 2

programme.title: 野火短劇Wildfire Mini drama
programme.desc: 戲子沈慕靈為追查師父離奇死亡的真相，結識了外表玩世不恭內心滿懷熱血的富家公子關行楷，兩人從最初的相互猜忌試探，到後來並肩作戰，在繁華鬧市的硝煙暗湧中，利用梨園戲台傳遞情報；他們不僅查明了真相，更在家國危難之際挺身而出，如星星野火般在亂世中燃燒自己，守護心中大義

programme.title: 勿擾飛升短劇Flying Up Without Disturb Mini drama
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師

programme.title: 開始跳舞吧 第2季Ready To Dance Season 2
programme.desc: 第2季邀請了來自粵港澳地區的街舞少年團參加，並由贊多敖子逸王晨藝黃譽博等擔任街舞領軍人物，少年們在他們的帶領下，分別進行初舞台合作舞台以及最終的留名舞台三個階段的挑戰，通過動感的音樂和充滿激情的舞蹈，將中國傳統文化特色與街舞文化相結合

programme.title: INSPIRASI
programme.desc: Inspirasi kali ini bersama Al Rumie dalam sebuah program temu bual yang menyelami kisah sebenar artis dan figura kreatif. Beliau berkongsi tentang jatuh bangun kehidupan, cabaran, dan kejayaan yang sarat dengan inspirasi, motivasi, serta pengajaran bermakna.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Pertemuan antara Tengku Maria dan keluarga baharu Aisyah memberi kesan yang mendalam buat diri Tengku Maria, alangkah hinanya dia sebagai seorang manusia yang menjadi penyebab wanita yang tidak bersalah hilang semua memorinya. Tengku Maria terduduk sayu apabila mendapat tahu kebenaran tentang keadaan Aisyah yang sebenar. Ketika kepulangan Aisyah ke kondo yang pernah menjadi sangkar dalam hidupnya, menjadikan Aisyah seorang yang panas baran. Dia bukan lagi Aisyah yang menjadi penurut segala kata Iskandar. Pertemuan pertama selepas 4 bulan berpisah di antara Aisyah dan Iskandar, benar-benar mengejutkan Iskandar bahawa isterinya itu langsung tidak mampu untuk mengingatinya, malah pelukan pertama selepas berpisah yang di hadiahkan oleh Iskandar kepada Aisyah di balas dengan satu tumbukan kuat di perut Iskandar. Iskandar redha jika jalan ini yang harus di lalui, dia termenung panjang memikirkan bagaimana cahaya hidupnya kini sudah tidak lagi mengingatinya. Setelah 2 hari di kondo, keluarga baharu Aisyah pulah semula ke kampong, kepulangan mereka membuatkan Aisyah sakit merindu. Kini Aisyah hanya hidup dalam memori bersama keluarga baharunya itu. Berat untuk berpisah namun Rokiah, Sarip, Anim, Azri dan Amani akur dan terpaksa juga melepaskan Aisyah untuk terus bersama dengan Iskandar. Sinar bahagia buat Iskandar kini kembali tetapi tidak buat Aisyah. Iskandar mula berusaha untuk mengembalikan ingatan Aisyah dengan setiap kenangan pahit dan manis yang pernah dilalui oleh Aisyah, namun usaha itu sering kali gagal.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Talia menangis dan mengaku kekhilafan dirinya di hadapan Antasya. Dia telah melukakan hati Syarfan namun setelah hati Syarfan terubat dengan kehadiran Antasya dia cuba merampas Syarfan semula. Syarfan dan Nazreth bebincang. Nazareth mengakui dia menyukai Antasya . Namun perasaan suka tersebut menjadi hormat apabila melihat hati luhur Antasya. Syarfan dan Antasya juga saling berdamai.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Fatimah dimarahi ibunya kerana terus berkawan dan keluar dengan Jazlee dan memberi nasihat supaya tidak kecewa bila direject oleh ibunya nanti. Khadijah, dengan rasa penuh kecewa dan sedih minta Jazlan untuk tidak membatalkan pernikahannya dengan Qasih yang telahpun dirancang dan diatur oleh kedua-dua ibu masing-masing. Aishah memberitahu Jazlee yang ibunya tidak benarkan langkah bendul dengan niat untuk memikat Jazlee untuk dirinya sendiri. Dengan lakonan yang amat menyedihkan, Alawiyah berjaya memujuk Jazlan untuk terus menikahi Qasih

programme.title: Bukan Kahwin Paksa
programme.desc: Demi ibunya, Rizrin berhijrah ke KL selepas melepaskan kekasihnya, Ariyana, kepada abangnya. Di sana, dia bekerja dengan Vee, rakan kepada Dara yang baru memutuskan hubungan dengan kekasihnya yang curang, Ryan. Sementara itu, Ariyana gagal melupakan Rizrin dan melarikan diri daripada abang Rizrin.

Namun, selepas kematian ayah Hawa, ibu Hawa, Suzana, enggan berhubung rapat dengan keluarga Adam, walaupun ayah Adam, Zul, beberapa kali cuba mendekatinya. programme.title: Jendela Hati
programme.desc: Liza seakan tidak percaya apabila Nazim mengadu apa yang berlaku kepada Farah. Dia bersimpati dan dapat merasai beban yang ditanggung Farah. Mengenangkan apa yang Lukman lakukan membuatkan Farah jadi makin jauh hati. Dia mula memikirkan masa depannya dan nekad untuk meneruskan hasrat menyambut pengajian di UK demi menenangkan jiwanya.

programme.title: Lelaki Melayu Terakhir
programme.desc: Jazlan dan Qasih selamat melangsungkan pernikahan mereka dan masuk ke dalam bilik Jazlan cuba untuk bersyarah mengenai hukum hakam agama yang Qasih perlu lakukan tetapi Qasih terlebih dahulu menyuarakan kehendak beliau dan syarat-syarat beliau di dalam perkahwinan mereka. Selepas balik dari rumah mama Qasih, Jazlan mengarahkan Qasih untuk menutup aurat dan memakai tudung. Beberapa hari kemudian Jazlan membawa Qasih balik ke Madinah. Jazlan dan Qasih mula menjalani hidup mereka sebagai suami isteri, dengan Jazlan sentiasa menitikberatkan tanggungjawab kepada agama dan tanggungjawab isteri terhadap suami

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Keadaan Talia semakin tenat. Segalanya dibantu oleh Antasya dan Syarfan. Hubungan Aiia dan Nazarin juga semakin rapat. Nazarin sering mencuri pandang ke arah Alia. Gadis itu istimewa baginya. Najwan masih menahan diri dari terus menyukai Syafinaz dan terus menjauh sebaik sahaja dia selesai bertugas. Syarfan cuba mencuri masa bagi membawa Antasya berehat dan membeli barangan bagi menyambut bayi mereka.

programme.title: Gostan

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Segala usaha semata untuk mengembalikan ingatan Aisyah telah dilakukan oleh Iskandar termasuk kembali ke kampong halaman Aisyah dan bertemu dengan Mak Su Ainin. Iskandar juga melakonkan semula episode hitam di mana dia dan Aisyah di tangkap khalwat dan dipaksa untuk berkahwin. Namun semua itu adalah usaha yang sia-sia. Mak Su Ainin dan Fasha gembira melihat keadaan Aisyah yang sudah hilang ingatan. Mereka semakin yakin segala harta milik arwah Puan Ainon dan Encik Latiff akan jatuh ke tangan mereka. Farid pula bersenang lenang dan yakin pada malam dia mahu merogol Aisyah tidak akan diingati oleh Aisyah. Sangkaan Farid meleset apabila saat Aisyah melihat wajah Farid dia ketakutan dan mahu melindunginya sendiri. Iskandar buntu bagaimana lagi cara untuk dia mengembalikan ingatan Aisyah sehingga dia berjumpa dengan Ros di sebuah gerai. Ros tidak dapat menahan perasaannya apabila Aisyah juga tidak mampu mengingingatinya. Ros mengajak Iskandar untuk menziarahi kubur kedua ibu bapa Aisyah kerana di situ lah tempat yang wajib untuk Aisyah pergi sebelum dia berkahwin dengan Iskandar. Di kubur, Aisyah menangis. Iskandar mula gembira dan menyangkakan ingatan Aisyah akan pulih.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya

Gadis itu istimewa baginya. Najwan masih menahan diri dari terus menyukai Syafinaz dan terus menjauh sebaik sahaja dia selesai bertugas. Selepas balik dari rumah mama Qasih, Jazlan mengarahkan Qasih untuk menutup aurat dan memakai tudung. Beberapa hari kemudian Jazlan membawa Qasih balik ke Madinah. programme.desc: Farah tidak mampu lagi memaafkan Lukman apabila sekali lagi bertembung dengan Myra di dalam rumah Lukman. Seluruh kepercayaan sudah lerai. Dia keluar dari rumah dan enggan berjumpa dengan Lukman lagi. Dia sanggup tinggal di hotel demi menjauhkan diri daripada semua orang. Lukman resah apabila tidak dapat mencari Farah namun hal itu disembunyikan daripada familinya. Segalanya berpunca daripada Myra yang datang ke rumah demi mengadukan konon dirinya teraniaya. Pihak pengurusan syarikat mendapat bukti bahawa Lukman terbabit dalam kehilangan wang syarikat. Abah tidak percaya dengan tindakan Farah yang nekad ke UK meninggalkan suami dan Zahin. Budi mengesyaki ada yang tak kena dengan kes Lukman. Farah pula menanggalkan cincin perkahwinan lalu diserahkan kepada Lukman. Dia sudah redha apa sahaja jalinan takdirnya. Lukman ditahan polis untuk siasatan kes pecah amanah.

programme.desc: Seorang sarjan Pasukan Operasi Khas Tentera Amerika Syarikat yang telah dibebaskan, James Harper, sanggup mempertaruhkan segalanya demi keluarganya apabila dia menyertai sebuah organisasi kontraktor swasta.

programme.title: Hani
programme.desc: Hani ialah seorang pelukis manga junior yang kembali ke Malaysia tetapi menghadapi masalah dengan tugasan terbarunya yang berkaitan dengan seorang patung berhantu.

programme.title: Mummy Reborn
programme.desc: Apabila sekumpulan remaja dalam kemusnahan kewangan memutuskan untuk merompak kedai antik tempatan, mereka menemui sebuah kubur kayu lama yang mengandungi mayat Mumia dan azimat purba. Tetapi apa yang mereka tidak sedar adalah kubur ini terkutuk, dan apabila azimat itu dipisahkan daripada tuannya, dia akan melakukan apa sahaja untuk mendapatkannya kembali. Pencuri kita mesti menyelamatkan hari ini dan mengembalikan Mumia ke kuburnya sebelum terlambat untuk menyelamatkan dunia.

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK, kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato Hashim. Ketika Dato Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.title: Hysteria! EP5

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Doctor is sick
programme.desc: Produced by the team behind News Hotline, this show flips the script on medical series by focusing on doctors who become patients themselves. It follows healthcare professionals as they face serious illnesses and health crises, highlighting how they handle vulnerability, diagnosis, and personal struggle behind the white coat.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Mutual Affection
programme.desc: Rich and talented scholar Sheung Liu Wai Hung was well-known to be a playboy. He like to fool around with his friend Por Lam Ka Tung. One day, they met the beautiful Dip Gigi Fu and Por was determined to win her hand. Sheung, therefore, helped Por by courting Dips maid Ngor Esther Kwan. Ngor disliked Sheung at first, but Sheung managed to impress her with his wit. When Sheung married Ngor, his nightmare started. Ngor interfered with everything he did and gradually he became henpecked. Then he had an affair with the lovely and gentle Cho Chan Mui Hing. Ngor was furious when she learnt about it and she told the Emperor. As a punishment, the Emperor ordered that Sheung could never see Ngor again

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.
